title: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart
description:
The intergalactic adventurers are back with a bang in Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart! 
 
 Go dimension-hopping with Ratchet and Clank as they venture onto a PC near you for the very first time. Help them take on an evil emperor from another reality as you jump between action-packed worlds and beyond.
 
 With their own universe next in the firing line, dust off the dynamic pair’s outrageous weaponry and stop a dimensional collapse in its tracks!
 
 Unite the double team supreme with a cast of familiar allies and new faces, including newcomer Rivet. She’s a Lombax resistance fighter from another dimension, who is just as determined to take out the robotic scourge. 

DualSense wireless controller integration 

• Enjoy a dazzling interdimensional adventure. Developed by acclaimed studio Insomniac Games and brought to PC by Nixxes Software, you’ll go beyond what you see with in-game actions coming to life in your hands via the DualSense wireless controller.*
 
• Haptic feedback and adaptive trigger technology create lifelike sensations: feel the hum of a spacecraft vibrate across the surface of the controller, or the kick of pulling your trusty Enforcer’s trigger. 

PC features   

• Blast your way through an interdimensional adventure as Ratchet and Clank make their way to PC for the very first time! 
   
• Wrap your eyes around delightful, diverse dimensions, with ultra-wide support for 21:9, 32:9, and 48:9 (triple monitor support) resolutions!*
   
• See the omniverse brought to life with the option of unlocked frame rates! You can also enjoy ray-traced reflections, as well as newly added, ray-traced shadows for exteriors.**
   
• Witness the latest upscaling technologies, including NVIDIA DLSS 3, AMD FSR 2, Intel XeSS and Insomniac Games’ Temporal Injection. NVIDIA Reflex and image quality-enhancing NVIDIA DLAA are also supported. Tailor a variety of graphics quality options to a range of devices, from high-end PCs to portable PC gaming devices.
   
• Play with the DualSense controller to experience haptic feedback and dynamic trigger effects.*** 

• Or choose mouse and keyboard – with a wide range of control customization options.
  
• Includes support for achievements and cloud saves on PC game launchers.   

Join the heroes  

• Employ an epic arsenal of explosive weapons, including the Burst Pistol, Topiary Sprinkler and the Shatterbomb. 
   
• Zip above cityscapes, boost into combat and slip through dimensions with physics-defying new gadgets. 
   
• Connect with the sounds of combat and explore in wonder as worlds come to life, enveloping you with high fidelity sound. 
   
• Sense the impact of in-game rumbles and explosions through the DualSense wireless controller’s haptic feedback.  

 Travel in style  

• Planet-hop with abandon as this adventure sends you hurtling across the galaxy at hyper-speed. 
  
• Experience the intergalactic shuffle of dimensional rifts as they combine new worlds and gameplay. 
   
• Warp across battlefields to rapidly gain your combat advantage and repair planetary rifts with dimension-spanning puzzles. 
  
• Explore never-before-seen planets and see alternate dimension versions of old favorites, now more alive than ever with exotic flora and fauna.   

An epic journey awaits   

• Play as Ratchet and as newcomer Rivet – a Lombax resistance fighter from another dimension. 
   
• Discover Clank’s all-new interdimensional mechanics.   
  
* Compatible PC and display device required. 
 ** Compatible PC and graphics card required for enhanced graphics. 
 *** Wired connection required to experience the full range of in-game controller features.

¡Los aventureros intergalácticos protagonizan un regreso espectacular en Ratchet & Clank: Una dimensión aparte!
 
 Salta de dimensión en dimensión junto a nuestros héroes por primera vez en tu PC. Ayúdalos a derrotar a un malvado emperador de otra realidad viajando entre mundos cargados de acción y más allá.
 
 Con el destino de su propio universo en juego, ¡desempolva el brutal arsenal de este dúo dinámico y evita un colapso dimensional!
 
 Crea un doble equipo de ensueño con un reparto de aliados conocidos y de caras nuevas, como Rivet, una nueva luchadora lombax de la Resistencia de otra dimensión, tan decidida como tú a eliminar a la amenaza robótica. 

Integración del mando inalámbrico DualSense

Disfruta de una espectacular aventura interdimensional. Desarrollada por el aclamado estudio Insomniac Games y adaptada para PC por Nixxes Software, no solo verás la acción, sino que cobrará vida en tus manos con el mando inalámbrico DualSense.*
 
 Con la retroalimentación háptica y los gatillos adaptativos experimentarás sensaciones realistas: siente el zumbido de una nave espacial vibrar en la superficie del mando o el retroceso al apretar el gatillo de tu fiel Ejecutor. 

Características en PC   

• Ábrete paso a través de una aventura interdimensional con Ratchet y Clank, ¡ahora por primera vez en PC! 
  
• ¡Admira las vastas y espectaculares dimensiones gracias a la compatibilidad con monitores con relación de aspecto 21:9, 32:9 y 48:9 (tres monitores)!*
  
• ¡Descubre cómo el omniverso cobra vida con la opción de tasas de fotogramas no limitadas! Disfruta además de reflejos con trazado de rayos, así como de las nuevas sombras de trazado de rayos para exteriores.**
   
• Descubre las últimas tecnologías de sobreescalado como NVIDIA DLSS 3, AMD FSR 2, Intel XeSS y Temporal Injection de Insomniac Games. También compatible con NVIDIA Reflex y NVIDIA DLAA de mejora de calidad de imagen. Adapta las diferentes opciones de calidad gráfica a varios tipos de dispositivo, desde un PC de alto rendimiento a dispositivos PC de juego portátiles.
   
• Juega con el mando DualSense para sentir la retroalimentación háptica y los efectos gatillo dinámicos3, o juega con ratón y teclado con una amplia variedad de opciones para personalizar los controles.
  
• Compatible con logros y guardado en la nube en lanzadores de juegos de PC.   

Únete a los héroes   

• Usa un arsenal épico de armas explosivas, como la Pistola de ráfagas, la Podadora y la Explosión pulverizadora.
   
• Surca el cielo de ciudades, lánzate al combate y salta de dimensión en dimensión con nuevos artefactos que desafían las leyes de la física.
   
• Reacciona a los efectos sonoros del combate y asómbrate explorando mundos que cobran vida, con sonido de alta fidelidad envolvente.
   
• Siente el impacto de los ruidos y explosiones del juego con la retroalimentación háptica del mando inalámbrico DualSense.   

Viaja con estilo   

• Salta de planeta en planeta en esta aventura donde surcarás la galaxia a hipervelocidad. 
   
• Experimenta los saltos intergalácticos por las brechas dimensionales, que combinan nuevos mundos y mecánicas de juego. 
   
• Viaja entre campos de batalla para ganar rápidamente ventaja sobre tus rivales y reparar brechas planetarias con rompecabezas multidimensionales. 
   
• Explora planetas nunca vistos y versiones de viejos favoritos en universos paralelos, ahora más vivos que nunca con flora y fauna exóticas.   

Tienes un viaje épico esperándote   

• Juega como Ratchet y la recién llegada Rivet, una luchadora lombax de la Resistencia procedente de otra dimensión.
   
• Descubre las nuevas mecánicas de salto interdimensional de Clank. 

 * Requiere un PC y una pantalla compatibles. 
 ** Para disfrutar de gráficos mejorados, requiere un PC y una tarjeta gráfica compatibles.
 *** Requiere conexión por cable para aprovechar todas las funciones del mando en el juego.

Les aventuriers intergalactiques signent un retour fracassant dans Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart!
 
 Bondissez d'une dimension à l'autre avec Ratchet et Clank, pour la première fois sur PC. Aidez nos deux héros à combattre un empereur diabolique venu d'une autre réalité en traversant à toute vitesse des mondes bourrés d'action!
 
 L'univers du super duo est le prochain sur la liste, et vous allez devoir dépoussiérer ses armes les plus insolites pour empêcher la dimension de s'effondrer!
 
 Notre tandem de choc va rencontrer un ensemble varié d'anciens alliés et de nouvelles têtes, comme la petite dernière Rivet, une résistante Lombax d'une autre dimension tout aussi déterminée à éradiquer la menace robotique.

 Intégration de la manette sans fil DualSense

Plongez dans une aventure interdimensionnelle époustouflante développée par le célèbre studio Insomniac Games et portée sur PC par Nixxes Software. Au-delà de la claque visuelle, vos actions prendront vie au creux de vos mains grâce à la manette sans fil DualSense.*
 
 La technologie du retour haptique et des gâchettes adaptatives produisent des sensations réalistes: ressentez le vrombissement d'un vaisseau spatial sur la surface de la manette, ou le déclic de la gâchette de votre fidèle blaster. 

Fonctionnalités PC   

• Lancez-vous dans une aventure interdimensionnelle avec Ratchet et Clank pour la toute première fois sur PC! 
   
• Contemplez des dimensions aussi somptueuses que variées au format ultra-large en 21:9, 32:9 et 48:9 (prise en charge du triple écran)!*
   
• Voyez l'omnivers prendre vie avec la possibilité de déverrouiller la fréquence d'image! Profitez également de reflets et de nouvelles ombres extérieures en ray tracing.**
   
• Bénéficiez des dernières technologies de mise à l'échelle comme le NVIDIA DLSS 3, l'AMD FSR 2, l'Intel XeSS et l'injection temporelle d'Insomniac Games. NVIDIA Reflex et la technologie d'amélioration visuelle NVIDIA DLAA sont également pris en charge. Adaptez une multitude d'options graphiques à un vaste éventail d'appareils, des PC haut de gamme aux PC portables gamer.
  
• Jouez avec la manette DualSense pour profiter du retour haptique et des effets de gâchette dynamiques*** ou optez pour la souris et le clavier avec de nombreuses possibilités de personnalisation des commandes. 
   
• Succès et sauvegardes Cloud des lanceurs de jeu PC pris en charge.   

Rejoignez le combat des héros    

• Déployez un arsenal épique d'armes détonantes, comme le Canon Plasma, l'Arroseur Automatique et l'Explobombe. 
   
• Survolez les mégalopoles, propulsez-vous dans les combats et traversez les dimensions avec de nouveaux gadgets qui défient les lois de la physique. 
   
• Prenez-en plein les oreilles au combat et partez à l'aventure dans des mondes plus immersifs que jamais grâce à des sons ultra fidèles. 
  
• Ressentez l'impact des grondements et des explosions en jeu grâce au retour haptique de la manette sans fil DualSense.   

Voyagez avec style   

• Sautez de planète en planète au gré de vos envies et atteignez les confins de la galaxie à la vitesse de l'éclair. 
   
• Vivez un voyage intergalactique inoubliable à travers des failles dimensionnelles combinant de nouveaux mondes et des mécaniques de jeu inédites. 
   
• Tournez le champ de bataille à votre avantage et réparez les failles planétaires en résolvant des énigmes entre les dimensions. 
  
• Découvrez de toutes nouvelles planètes et les dimensions alternatives de mondes familiers grouillant désormais d'animaux et de fleurs exotiques.   

Une aventure épique vous attend   

• Incarnez Ratchet et la petite dernière Rivet, une résistante Lombax venue d'une autre dimension.
  
• Découvrez les toutes nouvelles mécaniques de déplacement interdimensionnel de Clank.  

  * PC et périphérique d'affichage compatibles requis. 
 ** PC et carte graphique compatibles requis pour les améliorations graphiques. 
 *** Connexion filaire requise pour bénéficier de l'intégralité des fonctionnalités de jeu de la manette.

Die intergalaktischen Abenteurer sind mit einem Schlag zurück in Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart!
 
 Hüpfe mit Ratchet und Clank durch die Dimensionen, während sie sich zum allersten Mal auf einen PC in deiner Nähe wagen. Hilf ihnen, es mit einem bösen Herrscher aus einer anderen Realität aufzunehmen, während du von einer actiongeladenen Welt in die nächste und noch weiter springst.
 
 Ihr eigenes Universum steht auf der Abschussliste, also puste den Staub vom abgedrehten Waffenarsenal des dynamischen Duos und verhindere den Dimensionskollaps!
 
 Stelle dem Dream-Team-Duo alte Verbündete wie auch neue Gesichter zur Seite – darunter den Neuzugang Rivet. Sie ist eine Lombax-Widerstandskämpferin aus einer anderen Dimension, die ebenso entschlossen ist, dem Roboterparasiten den Garaus zu machen. 

Integration des DualSense Wireless-Controllers 

• Genieße ein interdimensionales Abenteuer. In dem vom gefeierten Studio Insomniac Games entwickelten und von Nixxes Software auf PC gebrachten Spiel erlebst du noch nie Dagewesenes, wenn die Action über den DualSense Wireless-Controller in deinen Händen zum Leben erwacht.*
 
• Haptisches Feedback und adaptive Triggertechnologie sorgen für ein realistisches Gefühl: Spüre das Brummen eines Raumschiffs, das über die Oberfläche des Controllers vibriert, oder den Rückstoß, wenn du den Abzug deines treuen Vollstreckers betätigst. 

PC-Funktionen   

• Ballere dich durch ein interdimensionales Abenteuer, wenn Ratchet und Clank zum allerersten Mal auf PC erscheinen!
  
• Wirf einen Blick auf wunderbare vielfältige Dimensionen mit Ultra-Breitbild-Unterstützung für Auflösungen von 21:9, 32:9 und 48:9 (Unterstützung für drei Monitore)!*
   
• Sieh dir an, wie das Omniversum zum Leben erwacht – mit der Option für frei wählbare Bildraten! Außerdem kommst du in den Genuss von Raytracing-Reflexionen sowie den neu hinzugefügten Raytracing-Schatten für Außenbereiche.**
   
• Erlebe die neusten Hochskalierungstechnologien hautnah, inklusive NVIDIA DLSS 3, AMD FSR 2, Intel XeSS und der Temporal-Injection-Technologie von Insomniac Games. NVIDIA Reflex und NVIDIA DLAA zur Verbesserung der Bildqualität werden ebenfalls unterstützt. Passe eine breite Palette an Grafikqualitätsoptionen an eine Vielzahl von Geräten an, von hochwertigen PCs bis hin zu tragbaren PC-Gaming-Geräten.
   
• Spiele mit dem DualSense-Controller, um haptisches Feedback und dynamische Trigger-Effekte zu erleben.*** 

• Oder wähle Maus und Tastatur – mit einer breiten Palette an Anpassungsoptionen für die Steuerung.
  
• Beinhaltet die Unterstützung von Errungenschaften und Cloud-Speicherung auf PC-Spiel-Launchern.   

Schließe dich den Helden an   

• Setze ein episches Arsenal explosiver Waffen ein, darunter die Blaster-Pistole, der Formschnittsprinkler und die Schmetterbombe.
   
• Mit neuen Geräten, die der Schwerkraft trotzen, saust du über Städte hinweg, stürzt dich in den Kampf und gleitest durch Dimensionen.
  
• Lass dich von den unfassbar klangtreuen Geräuschen beim Kampf oder beim Erkunden in Staunen darüber versetzen, wie lebensecht die Welten um dich herum klingen.
   
• Spüre dank des haptischen Feedbacks des DualSense Wireless-Controllers sofort, wenn im Spiel irgendetwas rumpelt oder explodiert.   Reise mit Stil   

• Hüpfe bei diesem Abenteuer nach Lust und Laune von einem Planeten zum nächsten und reise mit Lichtgeschwindigkeit durch die Galaxie. 
   
• Erlebe intergalaktisches Chaos, wenn sich Dimensionsrisse verschieben und neue Welten und Gameplay-Möglichkeiten entstehen lassen. 
   
• Warpe durch Schlachtfelder, um im Kampf schnell die Oberhand zu gewinnen, und repariere Planetenrisse, indem du Rätsel löst, die die ganze Dimension umfassen. 
   
• Erkunde noch nie zuvor gesehene Planeten und entdecke alternative Versionen altbekannter Lieblingsdimensionen, deren Flora und Fauna lebendiger wirken als je zuvor.   

Eine epische Reise erwartet dich   

• Spiele als Ratchet und als Neuling Rivet – eine Lombax-Widerstandskämpferin aus einer anderen Dimension.
   
• Entdecke Clanks brandneue interdimensionale Mechaniken.  

  * Kompatibler PC und kompatibles Anzeigegerät erforderlich.
 ** Kompatibler PC und kompatible Grafikkarte für verbesserte Grafik erforderlich.
 *** Kabelverbindung erforderlich, um den vollen Umfang an Controller-Features im Spiel zu erleben.

Os aventureiros intergalácticos regressam em grande em Ratchet & Clank: Uma Dimensão à Parte! 
 
 Salta pelas dimensões com o Ratchet e o Clank, à medida que se aventuram num PC perto de ti pela primeira vez. Ajuda-os a enfrentar um imperador malvado de outra realidade à medida que saltas entre mundos cheios de ação e viajas ainda mais além. 
 
 Com o seu próprio universo na linha de fogo, limpa o pó às armas absurdas deste duo dinâmico e trava o colapso dimensional!
 
 Une o derradeiro duo com um elenco que inclui aliados já conhecidos e rostos novos, como a recém-chegada Rivet, uma lombax das forças da resistência de outra dimensão, igualmente determinada a eliminar o vilão robótico. 

Integração do comando sem fios DualSense

• Desfruta de uma deslumbrante aventura interdimensional. Desenvolvido pela aclamada equipa da Insomniac Games e trazido para PC pela Nixxes Software, irás muito para além daquilo que vês, com ações que ganham vida e se manifestam nas tuas mãos através do comando sem fios DualSense.*
 
• O feedback háptico e a tecnologia dos gatilhos adaptativos criam sensações realistas — sente o ribombar de uma nave espacial a vibrar pela superfície do comando ou o coice quando premires o gatilho da tua leal executora. 

Características de PC   

• Abre caminho a tiro por uma aventura interdimensional com a chegada do Ratchet e do Clank ao PC pela primeira vez! 
  
• Desfruta de dimensões diversas e encantadoras com compatibilidade com ecrãs ultrapanorâmicos (compatibilidade com três monitores) para resoluções 21:9, 32:9 e 48:9!* 

• Vê o omniverso ganhar vida com a opção de taxas de fotogramas desbloqueadas! Também podes desfrutar de reflexos com ray-tracing e de sombras com ray-tracing em exteriores.**
   
• Testemunha as últimas tecnologias de ampliação, incluindo NVIDIA DLSS 3, AMD FSR 2, Intel XeSS e a injeção temporal da Insomniac Games. As tecnologias NVIDIA Reflex e NVIDIA DLAA de melhoramento de imagem também são suportadas. Personaliza uma variedade de opções de qualidade dos gráficos para um leque de dispositivos, desde PCs topo de gama até PCs de gaming portáteis. 
  
• Joga com o comando DualSense para desfrutares do feedback háptico e dos efeitos de gatilho dinâmicos.*** 

• Ou joga com o rato e o teclado — com uma vasta gama de opções de personalização de controlos.
   
• Inclui compatibilidade com conquistas e gravações na nuvem em iniciadores de jogos para PC.   

Junta-te aos heróis  

• Usa um arsenal de armas explosivas, incluindo a pistola de rajada, o aspersor de topiária e a bomba de estilhaços. 
   
• Atravessa cidades pelo ar, entra em combate a todo o gás e passa entre dimensões com engenhocas novas que desafiam a física. 
   
• Liga-te aos sons dos combates e deixa-te fascinar pela vida que os novos mundos ganham à medida que os exploras, envolvendo-te em sons de alta-fidelidade. 
  
• Sente o impacto das explosões e do ribombar do jogo através do feedback háptico do comando sem fios DualSense.   

Viaja em estilo   

• Salta despreocupadamente de planeta em planeta enquanto esta aventura te faz viajar pela galáxia a velocidades alucinantes. 
  
• Vive a aleatoriedade intergaláctica das fendas dimensionais, que combinam jogabilidade e mundos novos. 
  
• Teletransporta-te pelos campos de batalha para ganhares rapidamente vantagem em combate e repara fendas planetárias com quebra-cabeças que transpõem dimensões. 
  
• Visita planetas nunca antes vistos e dimensões alternativas de alguns dos planetas favoritos dos fãs — agora com mais vida que nunca, repletos de flora e fauna exóticas.  

 Espera-te uma jornada épica   

• Joga na pele do Ratchet e da recém-chegada Rivet — uma lombax das forças da resistência de outra dimensão.
  
• Descobre as novas mecânicas interdimensionais do Clank.  

  * Requer PC e dispositivo de visualização compatíveis. 
 ** Os gráficos melhorados requerem PC e placa gráfica compatíveis. 
 *** Requer ligação por cabo para desfrutar de todas as funcionalidades do comando no jogo.

De intergalaktiske eventyre er tilbage med et brag i Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart! 
 
 Hop rundt i dimensionerne med Ratchet og Clank, når de rejser ud på eventyr på en pc nær dig for allerførste gang. Hjælp dem med at bekæmpe en ond kejser fra en anden virkelighed, og spring mellem actionspækkede verdener. 
 
 Deres eget univers står for skud denne gang, så nu er det tid til at støve vennernes utrolige våbenarsenal af og stoppe et dimensionskollaps, inden det er for sent!
 
Foren det overlegne team med både en række velkendte allierede og helt nye ansigter – blandt andet Rivet, en helt ny lombax-modstandskriger fra en anden dimension, der sætter alt ind på at udrydde truslen fra robotterne. 

Integration af den trådløse DualSense-controller 

• Nyd et fantastisk interdimensionelt eventyr. Udviklet af det anerkendte studie Insomniac Games og udgivet til pc af Nixxes Software. Med den trådløse DualSense- controller vil du opleve meget mere, end du ser på skærmen.*
 
• Haptisk feedback og adaptive aftrækkere udløser teknologi, der skaber livagtige situationer: Mærk summen i et rumskib over controllerens overflade, eller oplev smældet, når du affyrer din trofaste Enforcer.

 Pc-funktioner  

 • Skyd dig gennem et interdimensionelt eventyr, når Ratchet and Clank finder vej til pc for første gang nogensinde! 
  
• Forkæl dine øjne med vidunderlige, alsidige dimensioner med understøttelse af ultra-wide til opløsninger i 21:9, 32:9 og 48:9 (tredobbelt skærmsupport)!*
   
• Se omniverset vakt til live med mulighed for oplåste billedfrekvenser! Du kan også opleve ray-traced refleksioner samt helt nye ray-traced skygger til eksteriørerne.**
  
• Oplev de seneste opskaleringsteknologier som fx. NVIDIA DLSS 3, AMD FSR 2, Intel XeSS og Insomniac Games’ Temporal Injection. NVIDIA Reflex og den billedforbedrende NVIDIA DLAA understøttes også. Skræddersy en række grafikindstillinger til et bredt udvalg af enheder, fra pc'ere i højkvalitet til bærbare enheder til pc-gaming
 
  • Spil med DualSense-controlleren for at opleve haptisk feedback med dynamiske aftrækkereffekter.*** 

• Eller vælg mus og tastatur – med et bredt udvalg af tilpasningsmuligheder for spilstyring. 
   
• Inkluderer understøttelse af bedrifter og mulighed for at gemme i skyen på spil-launchers til PC.   

Slut dig til heltene   

• Brug et episk arsenal af eksplosive våben som Burst Pistol, Topiary Sprinkler og Shatterbomb. 
   
• Sus over bylandskaber, kast dig ud i kamp, og hop gennem dimensioner med nye gadgets, der trodser fysikkens love. 
   
• Du vil virkelig høre lydene fra både kampe og spilverdenen i høj og livagtig kvalitet. 
   
• Mærk sammenstød og eksplosioner via den trådløse DualSense-controllers haptiske feedback.  

 Rejs med stil   

• Spring frit rundt mellem planeter, når eventyret sender dig rundt i hele galaksen med hyperfart. 
   
• Oplev alle de nye verdener og spilelementer, der opstår i dimensionsåbningernes intergalaktiske dans. 
   
• Rejs gennem slagmarker for hurtigt at vinde en fordel og reparere planetiske rifter med dimensionsbrydende hovedbrud. 
   
• Udforsk helt nye planeter, og alternative versioner af gamle favoritter, som nu er endnu mere levende end nogensinde før med eksotisk flora og fauna.   

En episk rejse venter   

• Spil som Ratchet og den nye Rivet – en lombax-modstandskriger fra en anden dimension.
   
• Oplev Clanks helt nye interdimensionelle mekanik. 
 
  * Kræver kompatibel pc og skærm. 
 ** Forbedret grafik kræver kompatibel pc og grafikkort. 
 *** Kræver kabeltilslutning for at opleve det komplette udvalg af controllerfunktioner i spillet.

Gli avventurieri intergalattici sono tornati alla grande in Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart! 
 
 Fate un salto dimensionale con Ratchet e Clank, mentre si avventurano per la prima volta su PC. Aiutateli a sconfiggere un imperatore malvagio proveniente da un'altra dimensione, mentre saltate ad alta velocità tra mondi ricchi di azione! 
 
 Il loro universo è il prossimo nella linea di fuoco, quindi rispolverate le armi del dinamico duo e impedite il collasso dimensionale!
 
 Riunite la coppia suprema con un cast di alleati familiari e volti nuovi, tra cui la nuova arrivata Rivet. È una Lombax proveniente da un'altra dimensione, che combatte nella Resistenza ed è altrettanto determinata a sconfiggere il flagello robotico. 

Integrazione del controller wireless DualSense

• Vivete una straordinaria avventura interdimensionale. Sviluppato dall'acclamato studio Insomniac Games, e trasportato su PC da Nixxes Software, sperimenterete l'azione non solo con gli occhi: il gioco prenderà vita nelle vostre mani grazie al controller wireless DualSense*
 
 • Il feedback aptico e i grilletti adattivi restituiranno sensazioni realistiche: sentite il ronzio di una navicella spaziale che vibra sulla superficie del controller o la pressione del grilletto del vostro fidato Enforcer. Caratteristiche per PC   Affrontate un'avventura interdimensionale: Ratchet e Clank sbarcano per la prima volta su PC! 
   
• Riempite il vostro sguardo con dimensioni meravigliose tutte diverse, grazie al supporto ultra ampio per le risoluzioni 21:9, 32:9 e 48:9 (per le configurazioni a triplo monitor!)*
   
• L'omniverso prende vita grazie alla possibilità di sbloccare i frame rate! Potrete anche godervi i riflessi in ray-tracing e le nuove ombre in ray-tracing per gli esterni.**
   
• Sfruttate le più recenti tecnologie di upscaling, tra cui NVIDIA DLSS 3, AMD FSR 2, Intel XeSS e Temporal Injection di Insomniac Games. Sono supportate anche NVIDIA Reflex e NVIDIA DLAA, che migliorano la qualità dell'immagine. Personalizzate una serie di opzioni della qualità grafica per una serie di dispositivi, dai PC di fascia alta alle console di gioco PC portatili.
   
• Usate il controller DualSense per sperimentare il feedback aptico e gli effetti dinamici dei grilletti.*** 

• Oppure usate mouse e tastiera, con un'ampia gamma di opzioni di personalizzazione dei comandi.
   
• Include il supporto per gli obiettivi e i salvataggi in cloud sui launcher di giochi per PC.   

Unitevi agli eroi   

• Sfruttate un epico arsenale di armi esplosive, tra cui: Burst Pistol, Topiary Sprinkler e Shatterbomb. 
   
• Sfrecciate al di sopra dei paesaggi urbani, lanciatevi in combattimento e scivolate fra le dimensioni grazie a nuovi gadget che sfidano le leggi della fisica. 
   
• Entrate in contatto coi suoni delle battaglie e meravigliatevi nell'esplorare i mondi che prendono vita, avvolgendovi con un suono ad alta fedeltà. 
   
• Percepite l'impatto delle vibrazioni e delle esplosioni del gioco grazie al feedback aptico del controller wireless DualSense.  

Viaggiate con stile   

• Fate il giro dei pianeti con la massima disinvoltura in quest'avventura che vi farà sfrecciare ad ipervelocità attraverso la galassia. 
  
• Fatevi sballottare dal rimescolamento intergalattico di spaccature dimensionali, che combinano nuovi mondi e gameplay. 
   
• Attraversate i campi di battaglia per ottenere rapidamente un vantaggio in battaglia e ricucite le spaccature planetarie con enigmi che spaziano fra le dimensioni. 
   
• Esplorate pianeti mai visti prima, ora più vivi che mai grazie a flora e fauna esotiche, e scoprite le versioni alternative dei vostri personaggi preferiti.   

Vi attende un'avventura epica   

• Vestite i panni di Ratchet e della nuova arrivata Rivet, una Lombax proveniente da un'altra dimensione, che combatte nella Resistenza. 
   
• Scoprite le nuovissime meccaniche interdimensionali di Clank.  
  
* Sono necessari un PC e un dispositivo di visualizzazione compatibili. 
 ** Sono necessari un PC e una scheda grafica compatibili per la grafica potenziata. 
 *** È necessaria una connessione via cavo per sfruttare tutte le funzionalità del controller di gioco.
《瑞奇与叮当 时空跳转》是2016年发售的游戏《瑞奇与叮当》的续作，这是一款第三人称视角的动作冒险游戏，于 2021-06-11 登陆 PlayStation 5平台。在游戏中，玩家将与瑞奇与叮当一起穿越空间，对抗来自另一个世界的邪恶统治者、以超乎想象的速度在充满刺激战斗的世界间穿梭，尽享炫目的视觉体验和各式威力十足的武器。

brief:
The intergalactic adventurers are back with a bang in Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart! 
 
 Go dimension-hopping with Ratchet and Clank as they venture onto a PC near you for the very first time. Help them take on an evil emperor from another reality as you jump between action-packed worlds and beyond.
 
 With their own universe next in the firing line, dust off the dynamic pair’s outrageous weaponry and stop a dimensional collapse in its tracks!
 
 Unite the double team supreme with a cast of familiar allies and new faces, including newcomer Rivet. She’s a Lombax resistance fighter from another dimension, who is just as determined to take out the robotic scourge. 

DualSense wireless controller integration 

• Enjoy a dazzling interdimensional adventure. Developed by acclaimed studio Insomniac Games and brought to PC by Nixxes Software, you’ll go beyond what you see with in-game actions coming to life in your hands via the DualSense wireless controller.*
 
• Haptic feedback and adaptive trigger technology create lifelike sensations: feel the hum of a spacecraft vibrate across the surface of the controller, or the kick of pulling your trusty Enforcer’s trigger. 

PC features   

• Blast your way through an interdimensional adventure as Ratchet and Clank make their way to PC for the very first time! 
   
• Wrap your eyes around delightful, diverse dimensions, with ultra-wide support for 21:9, 32:9, and 48:9 (triple monitor support) resolutions!*
   
• See the omniverse brought to life with the option of unlocked frame rates! You can also enjoy ray-traced reflections, as well as newly added, ray-traced shadows for exteriors.**
   
• Witness the latest upscaling technologies, including NVIDIA DLSS 3, AMD FSR 2, Intel XeSS and Insomniac Games’ Temporal Injection. NVIDIA Reflex and image quality-enhancing NVIDIA DLAA are also supported. Tailor a variety of graphics quality options to a range of devices, from high-end PCs to portable PC gaming devices.
   
• Play with the DualSense controller to experience haptic feedback and dynamic trigger effects.*** 

• Or choose mouse and keyboard – with a wide range of control customization options.
  
• Includes support for achievements and cloud saves on PC game launchers.   

Join the heroes  

• Employ an epic arsenal of explosive weapons, including the Burst Pistol, Topiary Sprinkler and the Shatterbomb. 
   
• Zip above cityscapes, boost into combat and slip through dimensions with physics-defying new gadgets. 
   
• Connect with the sounds of combat and explore in wonder as worlds come to life, enveloping you with high fidelity sound. 
   
• Sense the impact of in-game rumbles and explosions through the DualSense wireless controller’s haptic feedback.  

 Travel in style  

• Planet-hop with abandon as this adventure sends you hurtling across the galaxy at hyper-speed. 
  
• Experience the intergalactic shuffle of dimensional rifts as they combine new worlds and gameplay. 
   
• Warp across battlefields to rapidly gain your combat advantage and repair planetary rifts with dimension-spanning puzzles. 
  
• Explore never-before-seen planets and see alternate dimension versions of old favorites, now more alive than ever with exotic flora and fauna.   

An epic journey awaits   

• Play as Ratchet and as newcomer Rivet – a Lombax resistance fighter from another dimension. 
   
• Discover Clank’s all-new interdimensional mechanics.   
  
* Compatible PC and display device required. 
 ** Compatible PC and graphics card required for enhanced graphics. 
 *** Wired connection required to experience the full range of in-game controller features.

title: Carcassonne: Hunters and Gatherers
description:
Carcassonne: Hunters and Gatherers is a standalone game in the Carcassonne series set in the stone age.

As in other Carcassonne games, players take turns placing tiles to create the landscape and placing meeples to score points from the map they're creating. The player with the most points at the end of the game wins.

Instead of cities, roads, and farms, Carcassonne: Hunters and Gatherers has forests, rivers, lakes, and meadows. Players' meeples can represent hunters (when placed in the meadows), gatherers (in a forest), or fishermen (on a river segment). They also have huts, which can be placed on rivers or lakes to get fish from the entire river system.

It includes many of the familiar mechanics from Carcassonne with a few new rules, including:
- A player who completes a forest with a gold nugget in it gets to immediately draw and place 1 of 12 bonus (menhir) tiles.
- A meadow is worth 2 points for every animal in it, except tigers, which negate certain other animals.
- A river segment is worth the number of tiles in the segment plus the number of fish in the lakes at each end.
- A fishing hut scores at the end of the game and is worth the number of fish in all the lakes connected by rivers.

The Devir edition includes (the relevant part of) the Carcassonne: King & Scout expansion

In the 2020 edition 
- Some of The Scout special tiles are transformed into menhir tiles of which there are more now.
- A deer scores 1 point, an aurochs 2 points and a mammoth 3 points on meadows. 
- Rivers score for fish in the river segments as well, not only the fish in the lakes at each end. Fishing huts likewise.
- Players each get 3 huts instead of just 2.

title: Arkadia
description:
Arkadia is a game about building the city and castle of Arkadia.

Players use builders, cards, workers, and neutral workers to build houses in Arkadia. Houses are built with the seal of one of 4 families; this family gave the building order and will get the building player its seal.

These seals can be changed for victory points. But seals are subject to changing values. The growing castle (every time a house is built, players also build on the castle) has the 4 seals on it as well, which decides the value of each seal. The castle is also the game's timer: once the second layer is built, the last round starts. The player with the most gold wins.

Released: Essen 2006.

Online Play

     Yucata (turn-based)

title: Underwater Cities
description:
In Underwater Cities, which takes about 30-45 minutes per player, players represent the most powerful brains in the world, brains nominated due to the overpopulation of Earth to establish the best and most livable underwater areas possible.

The main principle of the game is card placement. Three colored cards are placed along the edge of the main board  into 3 x 5 slots, which are also colored. Ideally players can place cards into slots of the same color. Then they can take both actions and advantages: the action depicted in the slot on the main board and also the advantage of the card. Actions and advantages can allow players to intake raw materials; to build and upgrade city domes, tunnels and production buildings such as farms, desalination devices and laboratories in their personal underwater area; to move their marker on the initiative track (which is important for player order in the next turn); to activate the player's "A-cards"; and to collect cards, both special ones and basic ones that allow for better decision possibilities during gameplay.

All of the nearly 220 cards — whether special or basic — are divided into five types according to the way and time of use. Underwater areas are planned to be double-sided, giving players many opportunities to achieve VPs and finally win.

title: Two by Two
description:
The floodwaters are rising and the animals need to board the ark!

In this deceptively simple game, players move their boats around a steadily deteriorating landscape, matching pairs in order to rescue stranded animals.

Animals that are rare at the end of the game are worth more points than those that are common.

Two by Two is #6 in the Valley Games Modern Line.

title: Castle Combo
description:
Castle Combo is a tableau-building game that combines simplicity with deep, engaging gameplay, offering highly satisfying experiences.

Each player will spend coins to draft 9 cards from 2 open markets on the table (the lower and upper city), creating along the game a 3x3 square of people interacting with each other to trigger instant effects and end-of-game bonuses.

Each turn, you add a character to your tableau — a seemingly straightforward action that packs a punch regarding strategic decisions. You'll need to carefully manage your Keys to influence the Messenger pawn at critical moments, as it controls which characters are available for recruitment from two different areas – peasants and nobles.

Balancing your Gold reserves is equally important, ensuring you can afford the characters that best suit your strategy throughout the game. Selecting the right characters is crucial to maximising their immediate effects and the points they will contribute at the game's end. Finally, carefully arranging these characters on your 3x3 board is key to unlocking their full potential.

After everyone has played 9 turns (i.e., everyone has 9 characters in front of them), the player with the most points in their tableau wins the game.

title: A Date with Death
description:
You're just an ordinary person... or so you thought. For your entire life, you've been narrowly avoiding death by pure luck... or is it something more? When a strange program suddenly appears on your computer, and someone claiming to be the Grim Reaper says he's come for your soul, your life as you know it is thrown upside down.
  
  As you delve deeper into the mysterious man that calls himself the Grim Reaper, you begin to wonder if fate brought you two together for a reason. Can you resist his charm, or will you fall for the one destined to take your soul?
  
       
  A Date with Death is a supernatural romance chat simulator visual novel about the week long bet you enter against the Grim Reaper to attempt to keep your soul. Create your own character, from appearance to pronouns, decorate your apartment, and spend the (possible) last week of your life getting to know the one hunting for your soul.
  
  
       
  💀  Make Your Character:  Build your own protagonist, from their physical appearance to their pronouns and name. Update them throughout the game! 
  💀  Design Your Apartment:  Decorate your apartment to your liking and create a cozy space that you'll love coming back to. 
  💀  Pet Your Furry (or scaley?) Companion:  Yes, you can pet the dog. Snuggle up with your furry friend in-between chats.
  💀  Choices That Matter:  Make decisions that will affect your character's fate and lead you to one of multiple possible endings. What kind of relationship will you have with the Grim Reaper?
  💀  Beautiful Art of the Babygirl Grim Reaper:  Fill up your gallery throughout your playthrough with beautiful CGs, backgrounds, sketches, and more!

  As you delve deeper into the mysterious man that calls himself the Grim Reaper, you begin to wonder if fate brought you two together for a reason. Can you resist his charm, or will you fall for the one destined to take your soul?
  
       
  A Date with Death is a supernatural romance chat simulator visual novel about the week long bet you enter against the Grim Reaper to attempt to keep your soul. Create your own character, from appearance to pronouns, decorate your apartment, and spend the (possible) last week of your life getting to know the one hunting for your soul.
  
  
       
  💀  Make Your Character:  Build your own protagonist, from their physical appearance to their pronouns and name. Update them throughout the game! 
  💀  Design Your Apartment:  Decorate your apartment to your liking and create a cozy space that you'll love coming back to. 
  💀  Pet Your Furry (or scaley?) Companion:  Yes, you can pet the dog. Snuggle up with your furry friend in-between chats.
  💀  Choices That Matter:  Make decisions that will affect your character's fate and lead you to one of multiple possible endings. What kind of relationship will you have with the Grim Reaper?
  💀  Beautiful Art of the Babygirl Grim Reaper:  Fill up your gallery throughout your playthrough with beautiful CGs, backgrounds, sketches, and more!

title: The Mermaid Mask
description:
In the pitch-black waters beyond a long-abandoned fishing town, the enigmatic captain of the world's strangest submarine has been murdered. Some say he was an immortal time-traveller. Others say he was a vampire, cursed to stay hidden beneath the waves forever...
  
        
  
  Found alone in a locked room, with only an ancient stone cauldron to suggest how he might have died, it's up to Detective Grimoire and Sally to piece together what really happened. Was it a curse, released from the cauldron? One of the submarine's eccentric crew? Or does the bizarre truth run even deeper...
  
        
  
  • Every clue is a fully realised 3D object waiting to be examined for hidden secrets  
 • Grimoire and Sally are back, and joined by a fully voiced cast of mysterious suspects  
 • A hauntingly beautiful original soundtrack performed by the Budapest Art Orchestra  
 • Explore every hand-painted inch of The Mortuga Submarine, where not all is as it seems...
  *Voice audio is only in English

En las oscuras aguas que rodean un antiguo pueblo pesquero abandonado, el enigmático capitán del submarino más extraño del mundo ha sido asesinado. Algunos dicen que era un viajero del tiempo inmortal; otros, que era un vampiro al que una maldición había condenado a ocultarse eternamente bajo las aguas...
  
        
  
  Tras hallarlo solo en un cuarto cerrado junto a un antiguo caldero de piedra como único indicio de cómo podría haber muerto, está en manos del detective Grimoire y Sally desvelar lo que realmente ocurrió. ¿Fue una maldición que salió del caldero? ¿Tal vez alguno de los peculiares tripulantes del submarino? ¿O la extraña realidad va aún más allá?
  
        
  
    Cada pista es un modelo 3D completo que examinar para revelar ocultos secretos
    Grimoire y Sally vuelven acompañados de un elenco de singulares sospechosos, todos con voz propia*
    Una banda sonora original tan bella como inquietante de Budapest Art Orchestra
    Explora todos los rincones pintados a mano del submarino Mortuga, donde nada es lo que parece...
    *Voces disponibles solo en inglés

Dans les eaux noires d'encre bordant un village de pêcheurs abandonné depuis des années, l'énigmatique capitaine du sous-marin le plus étrange au monde a été assassiné. Certains prétendent que c'était un voyageur du temps immortel, d'autres un vampire condamné à rester caché en mer de toute éternité...
  
        
  
  Après la découverte de son cadavre dans une pièce fermée à clé, avec un vieux chaudron en pierre pour seul indice quant aux circonstances de sa mort, c'est au détective Grimoire et à Sally de reconstituer ce qui s'est réellement passé. Malédiction libérée par le chaudron ou crime de sang perpétré par l'un des membres de son équipage, tous plus excentriques les uns que les autres ? À moins que la troublante vérité soit encore plus inattendue...
  
        
  
    Chaque indice est un objet en 3D travaillé dans les moindres détails qu'il vous faudra examiner en quête de secrets cachés
    Grimoire et Sally sont de retour, flanqués d'une galerie de mystérieux suspects aux voix entièrement doublées
    Une bande originale à la beauté envoûtante interprétée par le Budapest Art Orchestra
    Explorez chacun des décors peints à la main du sous-marin Mortuga, un lieu où les apparences sont trompeuses...
    *Doublage en anglais uniquement

Der mysteriöse Kapitän des seltsamsten U-Boots der Welt wurde in den tiefschwarzen Gewässern in der Nähe eines verlassenen Fischerdorfes ermordet. Es wird gemunkelt, dass er ein unsterblicher Zeitreisender war. Oder ein Vampir – dazu verdammt, für immer unter den Wellen verborgen zu bleiben ...
  
        
  
  Er wurde allein in einem verschlossenen Raum gefunden, in dem nur ein alter Steinkessel einen Hinweis darauf geben kann, wie er gestorben sein könnte. Detective Grimoire und Sally müssen herausfinden, was wirklich passiert ist. War der Kessel verflucht? War es jemand aus der exzentrischen Crew des U-Boots? Oder liegt die bizarre Wahrheit noch tiefer ...?
  
        
  
    Jeder Hinweis ist ein detailliertes 3D-Objekt, das nur darauf wartet, auf verborgene Geheimnisse hin untersucht zu werden.
    Grimoire und Sally sind zurück – zusammen mit einer vollständig vertonten* Crew mysteriöser Verdächtiger.
    Ein unheimlicher und schöner Original-Soundtrack, gespielt vom Budapest Art Orchestra.
    Erkunde jeden handgezeichneten Zentimeter des Mortuga-U-Boots, auf dem nicht alles so ist, wie es scheint ...
    * Die Sprachausgabe ist nur auf Englisch verfügbar.

Nel mare plumbeo di un villaggio di pescatori ormai abbandonato, è stato assassinato l'enigmatico capitano del sottomarino più folle al mondo. Per alcuni è un viaggiatore del tempo immortale. Per altri un vampiro, condannato in eterno a nascondersi negli abissi oceanici...
  
        
  
  Il corpo è stato rinvenuto in una stanza chiusa e con solo un antico calderone a suggerire la possibile dinamica degli eventi. Un mistero che solo i detective Grimoire e Sally possono ricostruire. Che sia stata una maledizione celata nel calderone? O uno degli eccentrici ospiti del sottomarino? Forse la verità è ancora più assurda e indecifrabile...

    Grimoire e Sally sono tornati, insieme a un cast di misteriosi indiziati, interamente doppiato*
    Una straordinaria e spettrale colonna sonora eseguita dalla Budapest Art Orchestra
    Esplora ogni anfratto degli scenari disegnati a mano del sottomarino Mortuga, dove non tutto è come appare...
    *Doppiaggio disponibile solo in inglese

title: Bad Magpie Demo
description:
Bad Magpie  is a narrative adventure game about a magpie with one wing, a fixation on shiny things, and no interest in connecting the two dots.
  This demo drops you into a corner of one of the three areas in  Bad Magpie's  chaotic and colourful world, along with your first glimpse of the story behind the magpie's obsessive quest for shiny trinkets.
  In the full version, the story is told entirely through gameplay. For this demo, we've added a few lines of text before and after the gameplay to help set the scene.
  Your goal is to collect meteorite shards scattered across the map. Only the truly obsessive find them all.
   YOU ARE A MAGPIE         
  One wing. No flock. One obsession: a fallen star that wants shiny trinkets and nothing else.
  Burn a meadow, drain a swimming pool, write off a car… You can't fly but there are plenty of other ways to navigate the world… and you’re going to try all of them.
  Your plan is simple: Find the trinkets. Win over the star. Cure your loneliness. 
   A WORLD TEEMING WITH SECRETS         
  Explore a  densely packed, non-linear open world full of things to peck, steal, combine, and meddle with.
   Bad Magpie  runs on a delightfully elastic cartoon logic. Screech into a megaphone to shatter glass. Peck flint to spark fires. Drop an apple in oil and see what happens.
  Tear through the world in a fury, or carefully sweep every corner leaving no stone unpecked. There's no dialogue, no text, and no cutscenes. Just a world that rewards anyone curious enough to mess with it.
  Every puzzle has multiple solutions. Most of them are intentional.
   FIND SHINY THINGS         
  You want the star. The star wants trinkets. But trinkets don’t come free. Not when there’s meteorites to be found.
  So what’s the use of wallowing? You have shiny things to find.
   A MYSTERY DRIVING THE WHOLE THING         
  You are haunted by a mysterious vision. What is it? Why is it appearing now? And how long will the star keep you distracted from it? 
  It's probably nothing.
   KEY FEATURES     A luscious handcrafted world, reactive and brimming with life.
    Slapstick “got your nose” comedy.
    A cast of adorable critters to manipulate and terrorise.
    ASMR tactile interactions. Every peck, pull, and prod has been designed with maximum juiciness in mind.
    A dynamic score that orchestrates (and enables) your mischief.
    Disguises to unlock and hidden mechanics to discover.
    A powerful emotional narrative at the heart of everything, told without a single word of text or dialogue.
    
   One for sorrow… Two for joy?

Bad Magpie   es una aventura narrativa sobre una urraca con una sola ala, una fijación por las cosas brillantes y ningún interés en atar cabos.
  En esta demo jugarás en una de las tres zonas del caótico y colorido mundo de Bad Magpie. Esto te ofrecerá una pequeña muestra de la historia trás la obsesión de la urraca por las cosas brillantes. 
  Tu objetivo es recoger los fragmentos de meteorito que hay por el mapa. Solo la auténtica obsesión te permitirá hallarlos todos.
   ERES UNA URRACA         
  Una sola ala. Sin bandada. Y una obsesión: una estrella caída que solo quiere cositas brillantes.
   
  Quema el prado, seca una piscina, cárgate un coche... No podrás volar, pero hay muchas formas de moverte por el mundo... y tú vas a probarlas todas.
   
  Tu plan es sencillo:
   
  Encontrar las cositas brillantes. Ganarte a la estrella. Curarte de tu soledad.
   UN MUNDO LLENO DE SECRETOS         
  Explora un mundo abierto que está plagado de detalles que picotear, robar, combinar y trastear.
   
  Bad Magpie funciona con una maravillosa lógica de dibujos animados. Chilla en un megáfono para romper cristales, pica pedernal para prender fuegos, suelta una manzana en aceite para ver qué pasa...
   
  Arrasa con el mundo con furia o estudia cuidadosamente cada rincón sin dejar piedra sobre piedra. No hay diálogos, ni texto, ni cinemáticas. Solo hay un mundo que recompensa a los curiosos que se atreven a investigarlo.
   
  Cada rompecabezas tiene varias soluciones (la mayoría intencionadas).
   BUSCA COSITAS BRILLANTES         
  Tú quieres la estrella. La estrella quiere cosas que brillen. Pero no son gratis, especialmente cuando hay meteoritos por ahí repartidos...
   
  Así que no le des demasiadas vueltas, que tienes mucho que buscar.
   UN MISTERIO COMO HILO CONDUCTOR         
  Te atenaza una visión misteriosa... ¿Qué es? ¿Por qué se te aparece ahora? ¿Y cuánto tiempo te distraerá de ella la estrella?
   
  Bah, seguro que no es nada.
   CARACTERÍSTICAS     Un precioso mundo elaborado a mano, que reacciona y está lleno de vida.
    Comedia bufonesca e inocente.
    Un reparto de adorables criaturas a las que manipular y aterrorizar.
    Interacciones táctiles con ASMR. Cada picoteo, tirón y movimiento está diseñado para ser agradable al oído.
    Música dinámica que pone la banda sonora a tus fechorías (y las hace posibles).
    Disfraces que desbloquear y mecánicas ocultas que descubrir.
    Una narrativa emotiva y potente como hilo conductor, contada sin una sola palabra de texto o diálogo.
    
   Más vale pájaro en mano..., ¿no?

Bad Magpie  est un jeu d’aventure narratif ayant pour héroïne une pie dotée d’une seule aile, obsédée par les objets brillants et dénuée de toute intention de faire le lien entre les deux !
  La démo vous propose d’explorer une partie d’une des trois zones du monde à la fois chaotique et bariolé de  Bad Magpie , ainsi que d’obtenir un avant-goût du mystère qui se cache derrière l’apparente obsession de la pie envers les babioles brillantes. 
  Votre mission consiste à récupérer des éclats de météorites éparpillés à travers la carte. Mais attention, seuls les VRAIS pros de l’exploration seront en mesure de tous les trouver !
   VOUS ÊTES UNE PIE !         
  Une pie qui n’a plus qu’une seule aile, qui a perdu tout contact avec sa volée et qui est animée par une unique obsession : une étoile filante friande d’objets brillants… et de rien d’autre !
  Incendiez une prairie, asséchez une piscine, vandalisez une voiture… Vous ne pouvez peut-être pas voler, mais ce ne sont pas les moyens d’explorer le monde qui manquent… et vous allez tous les essayer !
  Votre plan est on ne peut plus simple :
  Trouver les bibelots et vous attirer les faveurs de l’étoile afin de trouver un remède à votre solitude !
   UN MONDE REGORGEANT DE SECRETS         
  Explorez un adorable monde ouvert non linéaire regorgeant de détails à picorer, à chiper, à combiner et à bidouiller !
  Bad Magpie s'appuie sur une logique de type « dessin animé » délicieusement élastique : vous pouvez par exemple crier dans un mégaphone pour briser du verre, ou donner un coup de bec sur du silex pour allumer un feu. Ou essayez donc de plonger une pomme dans l’huile, pour voir !
  Explorez le monde du jeu à toute vitesse ou prenez le temps d’explorer chaque recoin en prenant soin de n’oublier aucun détail. Dans Bad Magpie, il n’y a pas de dialogues, pas de textes ni de cinématiques. Juste un monde prêt à récompenser celles et ceux qui sont assez curieux·ses pour le retourner dans tous les sens !
  Chaque énigme peut être résolue de plusieurs façons différentes. Et d’ailleurs, la plupart des solutions sont intentionnelles !
   TROUVEZ UNE MULTITUDE D’OBJETS BRILLANTS         
  Vous voulez l’étoile. L’étoile veut des bibelots. Sauf que les bibelots, ce n’est pas gratuit... Surtout quand il y a aussi des météorites à récupérer !
  Alors à quoi bon vous apitoyer sur votre sort ? Vous avez tout un tas de trucs brillants à trouver !
   AU CŒUR DE TOUT, UN MYSTÈRE…         
  Une mystérieuse vision vous hante. De quoi s’agit-il ? Pourquoi apparaît-elle maintenant ? Et combien de temps l’étoile arrivera-t-elle à vous empêcher d’y penser ?
   
  Bah, ce n’est sans doute rien d’important…
   CARACTÉRISTIQUES     Un monde fantastique entièrement créé à la main, incroyablement réactif et débordant de vie.
    Humour burlesque et situations comiques du style « Je t’ai eu ! ».
    Toute une série d’adorables bestioles à manipuler... et terroriser !
    Des interactions tactiles 100 % ASMR. Chaque coup de bec, d’aile et de serre a été conçu pour procurer une satisfaction maximale.
    Une bande sonore dynamique qui orchestre (et rend possibles) vos méfaits.
    De nombreux déguisements à débloquer et mécaniques cachées à découvrir.
    Un scénario aussi captivant que riche en émotions, raconté sans aucun texte ni dialogue.
    
   Une pour le chagrin… Deux pour la joie ?

Bad Magpie ist ein narratives Abenteuerspiel über eine Elster mit nur einem Flügel, einer Vorliebe für glänzende Dinge und keinerlei Interesse daran, eins und eins zusammenzuzählen.
  Diese Demo wirft dich in einen Ausschnitt von einem der drei Gebiete in Bad Magpies chaotischer und bunter Welt. So erhältst du einen ersten Einblick in die Geschichte hinter der besessenen Suche der Elster nach glitzernden Kleinigkeiten.
  Dein Ziel ist es, über die Karte verstreute Meteoritensplitter zu sammeln. Nur wahrhaft Obsessive können alle finden.
   DU BIST EINE ELSTER         
  Ein Flügel. Keine Schar. Eine Obsession: ein gefallener Stern, der nur Glänzendes will und sonst nichts.
  Zünde eine Wiese an, leere ein Schwimmbecken, schreib ein Auto ab ... Du kannst nicht fliegen, aber es gibt jede Menge andere Möglichkeiten, dich in der Welt zu bewegen ... und du willst sie alle ausprobieren.
  Dein Plan ist einfach:
  Finde Glänzendes. Kriege den Stern herum. Kuriere deine Einsamkeit.
   EINE WELT VOLLER GEHEIMNISSE         
  Erkunde eine vollgepackte, nicht-lineare, offene Welt voller Dinge, die du picken, stehlen, kombinieren und an denen du herumspielen kannst.
  Bad Magpie basiert auf einer wunderbar elastischen Cartoon-Logik. Kreische in ein Megafon, um Glas zu zerbersten. Picke auf Feuerstein, um Funken zu entfachen. Lass einen Apfel in Öl fallen und schau, was passiert.
  Sause als Sturm durch die Welt oder durchkämme sorgfältig jede Ecke, um an jedem Stein herumzupicken. Es gibt keine Dialoge, keinen Text und keine Zwischensequenzen. Nur eine Welt, die alle belohnt, die neugierig genug sind, sich in ihr auszuprobieren.
  Jedes Rätsel hat mehrere Lösungen. Die meisten davon sind beabsichtigt.
   FINDE GLÄNZENDE DINGE         
  Du willst den Stern. Der Stern will glänzende Kleinigkeiten. Aber die gibt es nicht umsonst. Nicht, wenn es Meteoriten zu finden gibt.
  Was bringt es also, sich in Selbstmitleid zu suhlen? Du musst glänzende Sachen finden.
   EIN MYSTERIUM, DAS HINTER ALLEM STEHT         
  Du wirst von einer mysteriösen Vision heimgesucht. Was heißt das? Warum taucht sie gerade jetzt auf? Und wie lange wird der Stern dich davon ablenken?
  Es ist wahrscheinlich nichts.
   MERKMALE     Eine üppige, handgefertigte Welt, reaktionsfreudig und voller Leben.
    Slapstick-Komik nach dem Motto „Ich hab dir die Nase geklaut“.
    Eine Schar liebenswerter Wesen, die du manipulieren und terrorisieren kannst.
    Haptische ASMR-Interaktionen. Jede Schnabelbewegung, jeder Ruck und jeder Stoß wurde mit besonderem Augenmerk auf maximalen Genuss entworfen.
    Dynamische Musikuntermalung, die deine Streiche begleitet (und ermöglicht).
    Es gibt Verkleidungen zum Freischalten und versteckte Mechaniken zum Entdecken.
    Eine starke, emotionale Geschichte, die das Herzstück ausmacht und ganz ohne Text oder Dialoge erzählt wird.
    
   Eine für Kummer ... Zwei für Freude?

O jogo Bad Magpie é uma aventura narrativa sobre uma pega com apenas uma asa, uma fixação em bugigangas e sem qualquer interesse em ligar os pontos.
  Esta demo coloca-te no canto de uma das três áreas do mundo caótico e colorido do jogo Bad Magpie ao mesmo tempo que te dá o primeiro vislumbre da história por detrás da missão obsessiva de uma pega por bugigangas brilhantes. 
  O teu objetivo é colecionar fragmentos de meteorito que estão espalhados pelo mapa. Apenas os verdadeiramente obcecados conseguem encontrar todos.
   TU ÉS UMA PEGA         
  Uma asa. Sem bando. Uma obsessão: uma estrela cadente que quer bugigangas brilhantes e nada mais.
  Queima um prado, esvazia uma piscina, destrói um carro... Tu até podes não conseguir voar, mas há várias maneiras de explorar o mundo... e tu vais experimentá-las a todas.
  O teu plano é simples: Encontrar bugigangas. Conquistar a estrela. Curar a tua solidão.
   UM MUNDO CHEIO DE SEGREDOS         
  Explora um pequeno mundo aberto densamente recheado de coisas para bicar, roubar, combinar ou interagir.
  O jogo Bad Magpie é baseado na lógica irrealista dos desenhos animados. Tu podes gritar num megafone para fazer com que o vidro se parta, bicar uma pedra para começar um fogo. E se tiveres coragem o suficiente coloca uma maçã em óleo e vê o que acontece.
  Corre pelo mundo sem olhar para trás ou vê cuidadosamente cada canto e recando. Não há diálogo, nem texto, muito menos cutscenes. É apenas um mundo que recompensa os que são suficientemente curiosos para o explorar.
  Cada puzzle tem várias soluções. A maioria delas é intencional.
   ENCONTRA BUGIGANGAS BRILHANTES         
  Tu queres a estrela. A estrela quer bugigangas, mas elas não são de graça. Não quando há meteoritos para serem encontrados.
  Então porquê chorar sobre leite derramado? Tens bugigangas para encontrar.
   UM MISTÉRIO POR DE TRÁS DE TUDO         
  Uma visão misteriosa assombra-te. O que é? Porque é que está a acontecer agora? Durante quanto tempo é que a estrela te vai distrair dela?
  Não deve ser nada.
   CARACTERÍSTICAS     Um exuberante mundo feito à mão, reativo e cheio de vida.
    Um humor de palhaço tipo "apanhei o teu nariz".
    Um elenco de adoráveis criaturas para manipular e aterrorizar.
    Interações tácteis em ASMR. Cada bicada, puxão e espicaçada foi concebida para ser agradável ao ouvido.
    Uma banda sonora que orquestra (e permite) a traquinice.
    Disfarces para desbloquear e mecânicas secretas para descobrir.
    No coração de tudo está uma narrativa poderosamente emocional, contada sem uma única palavra ou diálogo.
    
   Mais vale uma pega na mão... que duas a voar?

Bad Magpie er et narrativt eventyrsspil om en skade med en vinge, en besættelse med skindende ting, og ingen interesse i at lægge to og to sammen.
  I denne demo bliver du smidt ind i hjørnet på en af de tre områder i Bad Magpies kaotiske og farverige verden, sammen med et lille glimt af historien bag skadens ustoppelige søgen på skinnende skatte.
  Dit mål er at samle stykker af meteorit, som er spredt omkring området. Kun de mest besatte kan finde dem alle.
   DU ER EN SKADE         
  En vinge, ingen flok, en besættelse: en falden stjærne som vil have skindende skatte og intet andet.
  Brænd en mark, tøm et basin, afskriv en bil... du kan ikke flyve, men der er mange måder at komme rundt på, og du vil prøve dem alle.
  Planen er enkel: Find skattene, vind over stjernen, og hel din ensomhed.
   EN VERDEN FULD AF HEMMELIGHEDER         
  Udforsk en tætpakket åben verden fuld af ting der kan prikkes til, stjæles, slås sammen, eller pilles ved.
  Bad Magpie følger den elastiske og dejlige tegnefilmslogik. Skrig i en megafon for at smadre glas, prik til lidt flint for at starte en ild, smid et æble i olie og se hvad der sker.
  Verden kan både hurtigt rases, og langsomt udforskes. Der er ingen dialog, ingen tekst, ingen scener. Bare en verden som belønner lidt nysgerrighed.
  Hver udfordring har adskillige løsninger. De fleste af dem er hensete.
   FIND TING DER SKINNER         
  Du vil have stjernen. Stjernen vil have skatte. Skatte findes ikke gratis, ikke når der er meteoritter af finde.
  Så der ingen grund til at måbe, der er skinnende ting at finde!
   DET STORE MYSTERIE         
  Du gives en mystisk vision. Hvad er det? Hvorfor er den her nu? Og hvor længe kan stjernen distrahere dig fra det?
  Det er nok ikke noget.
   INDHOLD     En frodig håndlavet verden fuld af liv som reagerer på hvad du gør.
    Masser af slapstick comedy af "jeg har taget din næse" slagsen.
    En masse små og søde dyr til at styre og terrorisere.
    ASMR-fyldte taktile interaktioner. Hvert prik, træk og hak er designed så lækkert som muligt.
    Dynamisk soundtrack der orkestrerer (og opfordrer) dine løjer.
    Forklædninger af finde, og gemte mekanismer at opdage.
    En følselsesladet historie i midten af det hele, fortalt uden en enkelt replik eller tekst.
  
     En for sørg... to for glæde?

Bad Magpie  è un'avventura narrativa che ha come protagonista una gazza con un'ala sola, una fissazione per gli oggetti luccicanti e nessun interesse a collegare i puntini.
  Questa demo ti catapulta in un angolo di una delle tre aree del caotico e colorato mondo di Bad Magpie, offrendoti un primo assaggio della storia che si cela dietro l'ossessiva ricerca dei gingilli luccicanti da parte della gazza.
  Il tuo obiettivo è raccogliere i frammenti di meteorite sparsi per la mappa. Solo chi ha una vera ossessione riuscirà a trovarli tutti.
   SEI UNA GAZZA         
  Hai un'ala sola. Nessuno stormo. E un'unica ossessione: una stella cadente che desidera soltanto gingilli luccicanti.
  Incendia un prato, svuota una piscina, distruggi un'auto... non puoi volare, ma ci sono molti altri modi per esplorare il mondo... e tu li proverai tutti.
  Il tuo piano è semplice.
  Trovare i gingilli. Conquistare la stella. Curare la tua solitudine.
   UN MONDO PIENO DI SEGRETI         
  Esplora un mondo open world denso di dettagli e non lineare, pieno di cose da beccare, rubare, combinare e con cui impicciarsi.
  Bad Magpie si basa su una logica cartoonesca deliziosamente elastica. Strilla in un megafono per mandare in frantumi un vetro. Becca una selce per appiccare incendi. Lascia cadere una mela nell'olio e guarda che succede.
  Attraversa il mondo in preda alla furia, oppure esplora ogni angolo senza lasciare nulla al caso. Non ci sono dialoghi, testi o filmati. Solo un mondo che ricompensa chiunque sia abbastanza curioso da metterci il becco.
  Ogni enigma ha più soluzioni. La maggior parte di esse è intenzionale.
   TROVA COSE LUCCICANTI         
  Tu vuoi la stella. La stella vuole i gingilli. Ma i gingilli non si ottengono gratis. Non quando ci sono meteoriti da trovare.
  Quindi a che serve crogiolarsi nella tristezza? Hai delle cose luccicanti da trovare.
   UN MISTERO CHE MUOVE TUTTO         
  Una visione misteriosa ti perseguita. Cos'è? Perché appare proprio adesso? E per quanto tempo la stella riuscirà a distrarti da essa?
  Probabilmente non è nulla.
   CARATTERISTICHE     Un mondo fantastico realizzato a mano, reattivo e traboccante di vita.
    Comicità slapstick in stile "ti ho preso il naso".
    Un cast di adorabili creaturine da manipolare e terrorizzare.
    Interazioni tattili 100% ASMR. Abbiamo progettato ogni beccata, strattone e colpetto per risultare incredibilmente soddisfacente.
    Una colonna sonora dinamica che orchestra (e favorisce) i tuoi misfatti.
    Travestimenti da sbloccare e meccaniche nascoste da scoprire.
    Una potente narrazione emotiva al centro di tutto, raccontata senza una singola parola di testo o dialogo.
    
   Uno per il dolore... due per la gioia?

brief:
Bad Magpie  is a narrative adventure game about a magpie with one wing, a fixation on shiny things, and no interest in connecting the two dots.
  This demo drops you into a corner of one of the three areas in  Bad Magpie's  chaotic and colourful world, along with your first glimpse of the story behind the magpie's obsessive quest for shiny trinkets.
  In the full version, the story is told entirely through gameplay. For this demo, we've added a few lines of text before and after the gameplay to help set the scene.
  Your goal is to collect meteorite shards scattered across the map. Only the truly obsessive find them all.
   YOU ARE A MAGPIE         
  One wing. No flock. One obsession: a fallen star that wants shiny trinkets and nothing else.
  Burn a meadow, drain a swimming pool, write off a car… You can't fly but there are plenty of other ways to navigate the world… and you’re going to try all of them.
  Your plan is simple: Find the trinkets. Win over the star. Cure your loneliness. 
   A WORLD TEEMING WITH SECRETS         
  Explore a  densely packed, non-linear open world full of things to peck, steal, combine, and meddle with.
   Bad Magpie  runs on a delightfully elastic cartoon logic. Screech into a megaphone to shatter glass. Peck flint to spark fires. Drop an apple in oil and see what happens.
  Tear through the world in a fury, or carefully sweep every corner leaving no stone unpecked. There's no dialogue, no text, and no cutscenes. Just a world that rewards anyone curious enough to mess with it.
  Every puzzle has multiple solutions. Most of them are intentional.
   FIND SHINY THINGS         
  You want the star. The star wants trinkets. But trinkets don’t come free. Not when there’s meteorites to be found.
  So what’s the use of wallowing? You have shiny things to find.
   A MYSTERY DRIVING THE WHOLE THING         
  You are haunted by a mysterious vision. What is it? Why is it appearing now? And how long will the star keep you distracted from it? 
  It's probably nothing.
   KEY FEATURES     A luscious handcrafted world, reactive and brimming with life.
    Slapstick “got your nose” comedy.
    A cast of adorable critters to manipulate and terrorise.
    ASMR tactile interactions. Every peck, pull, and prod has been designed with maximum juiciness in mind.
    A dynamic score that orchestrates (and enables) your mischief.
    Disguises to unlock and hidden mechanics to discover.
    A powerful emotional narrative at the heart of everything, told without a single word of text or dialogue.
    
   One for sorrow… Two for joy?

description:
Numbers aren't worth anything in NMBR 9 unless they're off the ground floor and looking down from above.

The game includes twenty cards numbered 0-9 twice and eighty tiles numbered 0-9; each number tile is composed of squares in some arrangement. After shuffling the deck of cards, draw and reveal the first card. Each player takes a number tile matching the card and places it on the table. With each new card drawn after that, each player takes the appropriate number tile, then adds it to the tiles that they already have in play, with each player building their own arrangement of tiles.

The new tile must touch at least one other tile on the same level along one side of a square. A tile can also be placed on top of two or more other tiles as long as no part of the new tile overhangs the tiles below it; new tiles placed on this same level must touch at least one other tile, while also covering parts of at least two tiles and not overhanging.

Once all the cards have been drawn and the tiles placed, players take turns calculating their score. A tile on the bottom level — the 0th level, if you will — scores 0 points; a tile on the 1st level above this is worth as many points as the number on the tile; a tile on the 2nd level is worth twice the number on the tile; etc. Whoever scores the most points wins!

title: Key Harvest
description:
Key Harvest is the fifth game in the key series of games published by R&D Games.

The object of the game is to score the most points.  Players score points by placing tiles on their own country board.  One point is scored for each field tile in the player's largest group of connected field tiles and two points for each tile in their second largest connected group.

Points are also scored for the worker tiles a player places on their country board.  The number of points scored for each worker is equal to the number on the worker tile.  Worker tiles do not count as connecting tiles when calculating the largest group of tiles.  When played, a worker enables a player to take a special action.  Each player has their own team of six workers, known as farmhands.  There are also six townsfolk who can be acquired by any player.

There are usually six field tiles available at any time from the registry.  On their turn a player may bid for up to two tiles using crop counters.  The field tile being bid for and the bid in crop counters are placed in the player's store.  On their turn the other players may match the store owner's bid in both the number and type of crop counters.  If they choose to do so, then they place the field tile on their country board and pay the crop counters to the store owner.  If no other player has matched the store owner's bid, then on their next turn the store owner may place the field tile(s) from their store onto their country board and pay their bid in crop counters to the general stock.

When deciding how much to bid for a field tile, players will need to consider how important the field tile is to them and whether other players are likely to bid for the tile.  It is usually beneficial for a player to place field tiles into their store as that player will either obtain the field tile or receive additional crop counters.

When played, a worker tile must be adjacent to at least the number of field tiles as the number on the worker tile.  A worker tile cannot be adjacent to another worker tile.  If a player obtains a field tile for a space where they have already placed a worker tile, they must remove the worker tile.  However, if the worker tile can be replaced immediately (next to the required number of field tiles), then the player can benefit from the worker's ability again.  Getting these extra benefits is one of the keys to doing well in the game.

Players have two actions per turn.  There are four possible actions.  Each action can only be performed once per turn.  As described above, the actions include placing field tiles from the stores onto their country board - action (c), placing field tiles from the registry into their store - action (d), and placing a worker tile onto their country board - action (b).  Action (c) cannot be performed after action (d).  A player may also harvest crops by turning over some unharvested field tiles on their country board - action (a).

Field tiles taken from the registry are replaced immediately with field tiles from the bag.  The bag also contains a number of event tiles.  The event tiles, when drawn, affect all of the players, not just the player who drew the event tile.  When the tenth event tile is drawn, the game ends after two further rounds have been played.

One point is also awarded to the players who have the most of each of the types of crop counters at the end of the game.  No points are awarded for ties.  Points are tallied using the scoring track on the town board.  The player with the most points is the winner.

Nr. 4 in the QWG Master Print Edition series, as Demetra

If a player obtains a field tile for a space where they have already placed a worker tile, they must remove the worker tile.  However, if the worker tile can be replaced immediately (next to the required number of field tiles), then the player can benefit from the worker's ability again.  Getting these extra benefits is one of the keys to doing well in the game.

Players have two actions per turn.  There are four possible actions.  Each action can only be performed once per turn.  As described above, the actions include placing field tiles from the stores onto their country board - action (c), placing field tiles from the registry into their store - action (d), and placing a worker tile onto their country board - action (b).  Action (c) cannot be performed after action (d).  A player may also harvest crops by turning over some unharvested field tiles on their country board - action (a).

Field tiles taken from the registry are replaced immediately with field tiles from the bag.  The bag also contains a number of event tiles.  The event tiles, when drawn, affect all of the players, not just the player who drew the event tile.  When the tenth event tile is drawn, the game ends after two further rounds have been played.

One point is also awarded to the players who have the most of each of the types of crop counters at the end of the game.  No points are awarded for ties.  Points are tallied using the scoring track on the town board.  The player with the most points is the winner.

命运石之门（Steins;Gate）的Steins德语的意思是石头，音译：斯坦因）。强调：在故事中，名词创造者本人——冈部伦太郎/凤凰院凶真明确地指出：这个名词是没有任何含义的，与任何人和事件亦或者物件无关，而没有含义才导致了它却是本作最终的关键词。

5pb.Games于2008年推出了由社长志仓千代丸亲自企划并担当制作人的科学幻想作品[Chaos;Head]后，取得了非凡的成功与不俗的成绩。在改编为新番动画后人气更是经久不衰，在2009年年初推出的“增强完整版”性质的[Chaos;Head Noah]在次时代主机Xbox360上首周竟也卖出万套以上。携此作的空前成功之势，5pb.Games在2009年10月15日推出同系列新作[Steins;Gate]，前作的核心团队新加入话题人物组成了更强的制作团队。本作在发售后取得了超高的人气，超高的口碑与超高的销量。可以视为5pb.游戏分公司成立以来最为成功的一款作品。而其制作人志仓千代丸、剧本家林直孝也因此成为了人气飙升的话题人物。

命运石之门

冈部伦太郎–中二病的大学生，自称疯狂科学家-凤凰院凶真。他在“未来机械研究所”里发明了“电话烤箱（暂定）”，这个道具有着是类似时空旅行的惊人机能，能够对过去寄送电子邮件。某日，主角遇到了18岁的天才少女-牧瀬红莉栖，但是，就在数个小时前，主角才亲眼目击到她在大厦的屋顶遭到杀害…故事由此展开。

 因跌宕起伏的剧情与充满魅力的角色，以及运用当时最先进技术制作的画面，而深受众多玩家喜爱的不朽名作，如今将重生为“全新故事”。

 By exploiting mako, the life-blood of the planet, through their mako reactors, the Shinra Electric Power Company has all but seized control of the entire world. A ragtag group of idealists, known as Avalanche, are one of the last bastions of resistance.
 
 Cloud, an elite SOLDIER operative-turned-mercenary takes part in an Avalanche operation to destroy Mako Reactor 1 in the city of Midgar. 
 The bombing plunges the city into fiery chaos, and Cloud is tormented by visions of a bitter enemy long thought dead. 
 
 Once more begins a story that will shape the destiny of an entire world.

 Este juego aclamado por la crítica combina el combate tradicional por turnos con la acción en tiempo real, y se ofrece ahora por primera vez en Steam junto con FF7R EPISODE INTERmission, una nueva historia con Yuffie Kisaragi como protagonista. 
 
    
 
 HISTORIA
 
 Mediante sus reactores succionadores de mako, la savia del planeta, la Compañía de Electricidad y Energía Shinra prácticamente se ha apoderado del mundo. Solo un grupo de idealistas conocido como Avalancha opone resistencia a su dominio.
 
 Cloud, un Soldado de élite convertido en mercenario, participa en una operación de Avalancha cuyo fin es la destrucción del reactor de mako n.º 1 de Midgar. 
 La explosión convierte la ciudad en un infierno, y Cloud sufre alucinaciones de su archienemigo, a quien creía muerto. 
 
 Así comienza, una vez más, la historia que definirá el destino de todo un mundo. 
 
 * Este juego es un remake de FINAL FANTASY VII, lanzado a la venta por primera vez en 1997.
 Es el primer título de una serie de juegos basados en la historia del juego original, y comprende los eventos hasta la huida de Midgar, incluyéndose además elementos adicionales.

 ■ SYNOPSIS
 
 Le monde est contrôlé par la compagnie Shinra qui exploite la mako, l'énergie vitale de la planète. Dans la mégalopole de Midgar, un groupe de hors-la-loi idéalistes connu sous le nom d'Avalanche consistue l'un des derniers bastions de la résistance.
 
 Cloud, un ex-membre des troupes d'élite de la Shinra, accompagne Avalanche lors d'une opération de destruction du réacteur mako nº 1. L'explosion plonge la ville dans un brasier chaotique et Cloud est tourmenté par des visions d'un ennemi qu'il pensait mort depuis longtemps.
 
 Embarquez dans une grande aventure qui décidera du sort de la planète !
 
 * Ce jeu est une réinterprétation en plusieurs volets de FINAL FANTASY VII, initialement sorti en 1997.
 L'histoire de ce premier volet retrace la fuite des héros hors de Midgar et nous fait vivre les événements qui secouent la ville avec une profondeur nouvelle.

 壮大な物語や魅力的なキャラクター、当時の最先端技術が駆使された映像で多くの人を魅了した不朽の名作が、時を経て「新たな物語」として生まれ変わります。
 コマンドバトルと直感的アクションが融合することで戦略性は高くなり、現代のグラフィック技術によって『FINAL FANTASY VII』の世界をリアルに再現、再生しております。
 
    
 
 ■STORY
 
 星から吸い上げた生命エネルギー《魔晄》。
 《ミッドガル》――八基の魔晄炉を有する階層都市。
 魔晄によって世界を掌握した巨大企業《神羅カンパニー》と星を守るために立ち上がった反神羅組織《アバランチ》が激突する。
 元ソルジャーのクラウドは、傭兵としてアバランチの《壱番魔晄炉爆破作戦》に参加していた。
 魔晄炉爆破の余韻響く八番街。
 炎に包まれる街で、死んだはずの宿敵の幻影が揺らめく。
 消し去りたい過去の幻影に導かれ、彼女と出会う。
 花売りの女性が差し出した黄色い花。
 花言葉は――《再会》
 その刹那、ふたりを取り囲む黒い影――《運命の番人》。
 今、想いが再び星を巡る。

 This critically-acclaimed game, which mixes traditional command-based combat and real-time action, makes its Steam debut along with FF7R EPISODE INTERmission─a new story arc featuring Yuffie Kisaragi.

 By exploiting mako, the life-blood of the planet, through their mako reactors, the Shinra Electric Power Company has all but seized control of the entire world. A ragtag group of idealists, known as Avalanche, are one of the last bastions of resistance.
 
 Cloud, an elite SOLDIER operative-turned-mercenary takes part in an Avalanche operation to destroy Mako Reactor 1 in the city of Midgar. 
 The bombing plunges the city into fiery chaos, and Cloud is tormented by visions of a bitter enemy long thought dead. 
 
 Once more begins a story that will shape the destiny of an entire world.
 
 * This game is a remake of FINAL FANTASY VII, first released in 1997.
 The first title in a multi-part series, it is based on the story from the original game, up to the escape from Midgar, adding in new elements.

 Este juego aclamado por la crítica combina el combate tradicional por turnos con la acción en tiempo real, y se ofrece ahora por primera vez en Steam junto con FF7R EPISODE INTERmission, una nueva historia con Yuffie Kisaragi como protagonista. 
 
    
 
 HISTORIA
 
 Mediante sus reactores succionadores de mako, la savia del planeta, la Compañía de Electricidad y Energía Shinra prácticamente se ha apoderado del mundo. Solo un grupo de idealistas conocido como Avalancha opone resistencia a su dominio.
 
 Cloud, un Soldado de élite convertido en mercenario, participa en una operación de Avalancha cuyo fin es la destrucción del reactor de mako n.º 1 de Midgar. 
 La explosión convierte la ciudad en un infierno, y Cloud sufre alucinaciones de su archienemigo, a quien creía muerto. 
 
 Así comienza, una vez más, la historia que definirá el destino de todo un mundo. 
 
 * Este juego es un remake de FINAL FANTASY VII, lanzado a la venta por primera vez en 1997.
 Es el primer título de una serie de juegos basados en la historia del juego original, y comprende los eventos hasta la huida de Midgar, incluyéndose además elementos adicionales.
